tools.name: mimo_asr_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe an audio file to text with the Xiaomi MiMo speech model (mimo-v2.5-asr). The audio comes from a local file path or a log:/mem: handle. The call returns at once and the transcript arrives as an event (`mimo-asr.transcript`). Use it when a voice message or an audio file needs to become text; for the microphone keep using the voice panel.

audio.description: Audio file path (absolute, or relative to the bot workflow), or a log:/mem: handle.

note.description: Short label shown next to the transcript.

language.description: Language code such as zh / en; overrides the configured one.

summary.zh: 用小米 MiMo 语音模型把一个音频文件（或 log:/mem: 句柄）转成文字，立刻回执，文字稍后以事件送达。
summary.en: Transcribe an audio file (or a log:/mem: handle) with the Xiaomi MiMo speech model; the call returns at once and the text arrives later as an event.

tools.name: mimo_asr_gateway
tools.description: Read, start or stop the built-in MiMo transcription gateway, which serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1 for the voice panel. `status` shows the address, endpoint, model and whether the API key is set; `start` and `stop` control it.

action.description: status = read the state; start / stop / restart = control the gateway.

summary.zh: 查看、启动、停止或重启内置的小米转写网关（供语音面板的「转写接口」引擎使用），并读回它的地址与状态。
summary.en: Read, start, stop or restart the built-in MiMo transcription gateway used by the voice panel, and read its address and state.

description.zh: 小米识别完成：正文是转写出来的文字，meta 带备注、模型、来源与耗时。
description.en: Transcription finished: the text is the transcript; meta carries the note, model, source and duration.

description.zh: 小米识别失败：正文是原因，meta 带备注与来源。
description.en: Transcription failed: the text is the reason; meta carries the note and source.

changelog.0.1.0:
- 首个版本：小米 MiMo 语音识别 World。
- 内置转写网关：`127.0.0.1:<port>/v1/audio/transcriptions`（OpenAI 兼容）→ 小米 `chat/completions` 的 `input_audio`（`mimo-v2.5-asr`）。
- 工具：`mimo_asr_transcribe`（音频转文字，事件送达）、`mimo_asr_gateway`（查看/启动/停止/重启网关）。
- 事件：`mimo-asr.transcript`、`mimo-asr.failed`。
- 配置面板：端口、端点（cn/sgp/ams/按量付费）、模型、语言、密钥（.env 变量名或直接填）、超时。
- 密钥可复用 Coopanion 语音面板已存的 `DESKTOP_PET_ASR_API_KEY`。
